dct_description_sm: This study is a part of the Canadian International Polar Year (IPY) project 'Climate Change Impacts on Canadian Arctic Tundra Ecosystems (CiCAT): Interdisciplinary and Multi-scale Assessments'. The direct objective of this study was to provide vegetation information to water resource researchers and managers for assessing the sustainability of fresh water supply to arctic communities under a changing climate, and to city officers and community planners for reducing dust problems in neighbourhoods. The information may also be used for regional wildlife habitat assessment and global carbon cycle studies.
dct_title_s: Remote sensing-derived maps of vegetation around Iqaluit
